card.name: Capitalized INFUSION and DISCONTINUED, before U
card.fires_on: Fires on the piece just before the final U in all-caps words such as INF|USION and DISCONT|IN|UED. It appears in capitalized warning and dosing headings.

modes.label: INFUSION in caps
modes.description: The piece INF in an all-caps INFUSION, just before USION.
modes.example: WARNING: RAPID<< INF>>USION OF BUSULFAN IN

modes.label: DISCONTINUED in caps
modes.description: The piece IN inside all-caps DISCONTINUED, just before UED.
modes.example: SHOULD BE DISCONT<<IN>>UED AND APPROPRIATE THER

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict a following U-starting piece, completing the word.
card.plain: It fires inside capitalized words like INFUSION and DISCONTINUED, right before the final U part.
